title: I built a multiplayer space combat game with AI-assisted development — looking for playtesters and UI/UX feedback
author: LordBode
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’m a solo developer working on Deriva, a browser-based multiplayer space combat game.

🎮 Play it here: https://deriva-combat.io

The game is focused on space combat, ship control, different combat systems, and ship customization.

You directly pilot your ship, manage movement and energy, lock onto enemies, use missiles and special abilities, and experiment with different ship configurations and components.

The game is still in development, and I’d really like people to play it and give me honest feedback.

What was challenging to build?

One of my main strategies was to use SOLID principles and DDD (Domain-Driven Design) throughout the project.

Since the game has a separate frontend and multiplayer backend, I wanted the modules to remain as independent as possible, avoid unnecessary code duplication, and use dependency/class injection to make testing, debugging, corrections, and future expansion easier.

This was especially useful because of one problem I’ve noticed repeatedly when using AI for development: AI can fix one thing and accidentally break something somewhere else.

By keeping the architecture modular and the responsibilities well separated, this happened much less often and I was able to iterate with relatively little rework.

Another major challenge was network performance and lag.

There are a lot of objects and a lot of information being processed across the game, especially in multiplayer. Getting the architecture and data flow right made a big difference, and the game currently runs well both on desktop and mobile browsers.

The area where I really need help

UI/UX.

This is probably my weakest skill as a developer.

I’m much stronger at logic, systems, backend architecture and problem solving than visual design.

So one of the main reasons I’m posting here is to get feedback on the interface.

I’d especially love to know:

\- Does the HUD feel too cluttered?

\- Is the information hierarchy clear?

\- Can you understand what the different systems do without being told?

\- Does the ship/loadout screen make sense?

\- What would you change visually?

\- Is there anything about the UI that makes the game harder to understand or less appealing?

I’m also interested in general gameplay feedback:

\- Does the movement feel good?

\- Is the combat fun?

\- Does the game feel too complicated at first?

\- Do the different ships and systems make you want to experiment?

\- What would make you want to play another match?

I’m not looking for compliments just for the sake of it. If something is confusing, ugly, frustrating, or simply not fun, please tell me.

Even a few minutes of play and some honest feedback would help me a lot.

Thanks for checking out Deriva!
